picks.title: Werner Herzog on David Lynch, AI, and Why His Unhinged New Film 'Bucking Fastard' Skipped Cannes for Venice
picks.excerpt: At Venice, Herzog talks about 'Bucking Fastard' with Kate and Rooney Mara, his dedication to David Lynch, and dismisses an AI-generated documentary made in his spirit: 'I welcome AI to replace all the idiots who are into nothing but repeating.'
picks.rationale: A working director's sharpest framing yet of where generative video actually belongs — mimicry, not storytelling.

picks.title: Full Metal Lunchbox | Runway
picks.excerpt: Runway published a four-minute AI-generated war-movie parody staged entirely with food, chaptered like a feature.
picks.rationale: A first-party look at what Runway's current stack sustains across a four-minute cut, not a ten-second demo.

picks.title: Opinion: The AI Ad Selling Storage to the Filmmakers It's Replacing - Samsung's Portable SSD P9 Campaign
picks.excerpt: Samsung sold its 12K-RAW-ready Portable SSD P9 with a launch film and press stills generated entirely by AI, hallucinated lens text included; CineD's Nino Leitner calls out the irony.
picks.rationale: The clearest case study this week of brands routing commercial production — the crew's bread and butter — into generative pipelines.

picks.title: Art of the Frame Podcast: The Alan Smithee Round Table - What We Did Last Summer
picks.excerpt: Scott Simmons, Katie Hinsen and Michael Kammes open Season 5 on post's shifting software: Adobe's Topaz Labs acquisition pulling AI upscaling natively into its tools, Avid's new Media Composer Enterprise project-sharing requirement pushing Hedge to acquire Mimic, plus Kammes' own practical AI integration.
picks.rationale: Three working post pros mapping which AI shifts actually land in the edit bay this season, and what they cost.

picks.title: Ulanzi AU05 VibeKey AI Voice Input Keypad
picks.excerpt: A $61.59 pocket keypad with a push-to-talk voice key that pipes prompts into ChatGPT, Claude or Codex, plus three remappable keys and a control knob.
picks.rationale: Hardware that puts an AI prompt key on the edit desk for the price of a memory card.
